diagram.documentation:
The SKOS metamodel based on the imported SKOS skos.rdf showing annotations on classes and association ends

Note that skos.rdf appears as 'core' under Imported Ontologies in the model containment tree because this is the name assigned by the SKOS namespace URI http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#

 

Annotations are displayed for classes and association properties, but not for attributes of classes.

For annotations relating to attributes of classes see: SKOS Metamodel - Per RDF classes only (with attribute annotations).

For a cleaner version of the metamodel with no annotations, but full information on attributes of classes see, see: SKOS Metamodel - Per RDF classes and associations (no annotations)
